title: The Crow and the Sheep
summary: An insolent crow perched upon a sheep's back, pecking her wool....
full_text:
An insolent crow perched upon a sheep's back, pecking her wool.

The sheep sighed: "You dare torment me because I am gentle; if you tried that upon a mastiff, he would tear your wings to ribbons!"
moral: The bully preys upon the gentle, but flees before the strong.
